intro: One kuih ketayap (dadar) has about 150 kcal. Most of the calories come from the grated coconut and gula melaka filling, plus the crepe skin.
diet: Yes, one ketayap is easy to fit into your daily calories. The coconut and gula melaka filling makes it quite dense, so 2-3 pieces can quickly go past 400 kcal. Have one as a snack with an unsweetened drink. Even better if you eat it after a meal with protein.
tips: Take just one and save the rest for tomorrow.
If making your own, cut down the gula melaka in the filling a little.
Skip the sweet drinks, go for teh o kosong.

swap.name: Apam beras (1 piece)
swap.why: Still a soft, sweet traditional kuih, but without the sugary coconut filling. Saves about 50 kcal.

faq.a: The green colour comes from pandan leaf juice. Some people add colouring to make it brighter.

faq.q: How do I stop the ketayap skin from tearing?
faq.a: Let the batter rest a while and use a non-stick pan on medium heat. Batter that's too thick also tears easily.
Yes. Wrap each one and keep in a container. Steam briefly before eating.
